title: Harden Contact Sync delta URL and ownership checks
summary: Contact Sync now validates delta URLs against the approved Microsoft Graph endpoint and enforces record ownership checks to prevent malicious URL manipulation or cross-user record access.
key_points: Delta URLs are validated before persisting to ensure they match the https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/ prefix
Invalid delta URLs trigger fallback to full sync instead of failing
Record ownership enforcement prevents users from inserting or modifying other users' sync records
User ID field changes on existing records are blocked
Install and upgrade contexts bypass ownership checks to avoid regressions
